- Overall performance: Revenue after eliminations is INR 199.15 billion with a gross margin of 47.7% and EBITDA margin of 17%.
- The company that contributes most to the revenue is Wipro Consumer Care India, while the one that needs attention is not explicitly mentioned, but since Wipro Consumer Care India is the only company listed, it is the sole contributor.
- Margins are at 47.7% for gross margin and 17% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2025-12-01 is managed with 50 days of DSO and 78 days of DPO.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are profit centre 20 with a revenue change of INR 5.18 billion (51% of total change), everything excluding profit centre 20 with a revenue change of INR 4.99 billion (49% of total change), and profit centre 30 with a revenue change of INR 3.63 billion (35.7% of total change).
